input.space: Linear-transfer Rec.2020 / D65, developed from Apple RAW or ProRAW
input.normalization: DNG exposure/local-gain adapted linear RGB (RAW recipe v3); LUT reference middle gray = 0.18; no per-image peak normalization
input.domain: Finite half-float values; negatives and upper values follow official LUT domain clamping

rawDevelopmentContract.baselineExposure: Preserve DNG default (per-image linear exposure compensation)
rawDevelopmentContract.localToneMapAmount: Preserve DNG default for recipe version 3; zero for legacy version 1
rawDevelopmentContract.whiteBalance: Use captured DNG neutral; do not force 6500K
rawDevelopmentContract.calibration: DNG camera profile and exposure baseline retained; camera-to-camera color calibration not yet measured

outputViewingAssumption: Official white paper p13 recommends BT.709 / D65 / Gamma 2.2. Decode that reference view with power 2.2 and encode sRGB; LUT header itself specifies BT.709 gamut only.

runtimeContractRevision.reason: Retain DNG exposure reference and per-image local gain before the official global film curve. Numeric LUT tables are unchanged. Adapted linear RGB is not a radiometric measurement of the original scene.

runtimeUsage.canonicalCube: The previously named sRGB preview cube is the canonical display-referred look for all new RAW stills, HEIF, Live Photo and viewfinder frames. It accepts and returns encoded sRGB. The transform is a display interpretation derived from the official LUT, not a calibrated reproduction of a Fujifilm camera sensor.
runtimeUsage.legacyTables: JSRAW001 scene-linear tables remain for recovery of already checkpointed version 1/3 RAW jobs and regression verification. New camera captures do not load these tables.
